# Four Teams, One Festival

<!-- STEP id="teams-a-and-b" -->
## Teams A and B

At a 'Youth for Democracy' festival, Students' Councils from different countries visit your school. Each works in its own way.

Tap Team A and Team B, and read.

<!-- STEP id="teams-c-and-d" -->
## Teams C and D

Now read Team C and Team D. Notice who may contest, who holds the power, and whether other voices are heard.

Which team would you choose, and why?
